name: Unattended workflow failed
query: ci-pipelines("ci_level:pipeline @git.repository.id:\"github.com/vercel/next.js\" @ci.status:error @ci.pipeline.name:(\"Lock Threads\" OR \"Next Maintainer Auto Close\" OR \"Rspack Next.js production integration tests\" OR \"Rspack Next.js development integration tests\" OR \"Update Rspack test manifest\" OR \"test-e2e-project-reset-cron\" OR \"Trigger Release\" OR \"Update Font Data\" OR \"Update React\" OR \"Poll React Sync\" OR \"Triage issues\" OR \"Allow issue participants to reopen issues\" OR \"PR CI Comment\" OR \"retry-tests\" OR \"retry-deploy-tests\" OR \"upload-preview-tarballs\")").rollup("count").by("@ci.pipeline.name").last("15m") >= 1
